content: {"praised":["Beautiful music soundtrack and scenic locations.","Strong performances by Shah Rukh Khan and Rani Mukerji.","Sweet and funny scenes in the first half.","Engaging romantic storyline with relatable obstacles.","Good acting and chemistry between leads."],"criticized":["Love story feels unrealistic from start.","No redeeming quality beyond music and scenery.","Overuse of high‑profile actors feels unnecessary.","In‑laws portrayed as prejudiced and unsupportive.","First half lacks depth, feels like milk‑toast production."]}
